_about: What Nabeel said about a game and what was done about it, shown on the Game Review page (tools/review_page.py) as a green box on that game's card. His words are kept exactly as he wrote or said them. kind: 'yours' = his own review of this game; 'also' = the same fault found here from his review of another game.

police.said: In this game you're are supposed to be chasing a criminal but the game doesn't make it clear who the criminal is. Theirs should be a clear sign that this is the car. This is the only car you should be chasing. And once the criminal gets out to run the running graphics are just awful. Plus the skyscrapers randomly dissappear if you play the game for long enough Plus the car controls should be a joystick with a button for break acceleration anf reverse and a city shouldn't be just a straight line but turn and corners
police.did: A red arrow and ring mark the suspect's car. A stick to steer, with GAS and BRAKE (hold BRAKE when stopped to reverse). A city of streets and corners. Runners with knees and elbows. The buildings no longer vanish.

police.said: make it clear how do you arrest them... there should be a button for arrest this person, and maybe you make it fun. You have to tap quicker than they're resisting... when you arrest someone, the graphics are kind of messed up... the person when running should also be able to turn corners, and I can turn corners
police.did: An ARREST button. A tapping fight with a bar: tap faster than he resists. The arrest picture rebuilt. The alleys have corners: swipe the way the yellow arrow points.

police.said: you don't animate the person entering the car, nor do you animate them leaving the car
police.did: When his car is stopped you see him get out and run, and your officer get out after him.

taxi.said: you're literally taking them just around the corner... let the people drive for at least for some time. I'm talking like 3 to 5 minutes at least... you don't animate the person entering the car, nor do you animate them leaving the car
taxi.did: A passenger goes right across town (7 to 10 blocks; it was one). A shift is about 4 to 5 minutes. You see them walk to the door, get in, sit in the back, get out and walk away.

taxi.said: the car controls should be a joystick with a button for break acceleration anf reverse
taxi.did: You drive the taxi yourself: a stick, GAS and BRAKE. It used to drive itself.

pilot.did: The controls were upside-down (thumb down made the plane climb) and on the first flight up and down did nothing. Fixed, see the next box.

pilot.said: anytime I try to click the side button that'll take it up, it just takes me to the joystick... you have to make the joystick in a single location... If you press this one, it goes up in altitude. If you press this one, it goes down in altitude... left... right. That was fine. You don't need the joystick. But... when I tried to bring it down in altitude, it doesn't bring it down.
pilot.did: Four buttons that never move: UP, DOWN, LEFT, RIGHT. Press and hold. No joystick. DOWN takes the plane down and UP takes it up, on every flight including the first.

hunter.said: Once again horrible animation with the animal and the spear throw. Plus the animal  just waits for me to kill it it should run away or even attack if I run or come too close or throw a spear. The animation must better fot animal and spear
hunter.did: New animals with real legs, necks, heads, ears and tails: they graze, look up, gallop off and fall. Come too close or run and a deer or horse bolts. A boar, bison or mammoth may charge: wait for DIVE ASIDE, push the stick sideways, then it stands winded for an easy throw. The throw: the arm whips forward, the spear leaves the hand with a streak and sticks in the animal or the ground.

vine.said: You have to do better on the animation animation hands and the person holding the vines and swinging overall the animation needs to better
vine.did: A new swinger with elbows, knees, hands and fingers. Both hands close on the vine. The legs kick forward and tuck back with the swing. In the air the arms reach for the next vine and the legs stride. A grab at nothing sends the arms wheeling.

reel.said: Make the fish clear currently its just a circle make the fish come out of the water in the place I'm supposed to put my fishing stick even is just briefly.  If you have bad eyes you won't even see the circle you are supposed to put make the circle distinct from the water color so its easy to see.
reel.did: Fish leap out of the water where you should cast. Each place is a bright orange ring with a dark edge and an arrow over it. The aim ring turns green and says ON THE FISH when it is on one. While you fight a fish you see it at the surface, with a ring round it.

soar.said: The rings are ugly.  Make them nore pretty It doesn't even need to be a person flying you can just make a cape flying and flappy through the air. Make ghe surroundings really beautiful here its very important. Take your time renderings the surroundings. Make the game easier let me see the rings and be able to slowly go into them
soar.did: Rings of light with gems, each the next colour of the rainbow, and a trail of sparks leading to the next one. A crimson cape with a gold hem instead of a person. The surroundings: turquoise shallows and foam round the islands, flower meadows, blossom trees, palms, hot-air balloons, sailing boats, heaped clouds, a rainbow. Easier: you fly at half the speed on the first flights, the rings are bigger and closer, the trail is straighter.

run.said: the car controls should be a joystick with a button for break acceleration anf reverse and a city shouldn't be just a straight line but turn and corners
run.did: A stick, GAS, BRAKE and a NITRO button. A city of streets and corners with green arrows to the drop. Alleys with corners on foot.

run.said: you don't animate the person entering the car, nor do you animate them leaving the car
run.did: At DITCH THE CAR you see yourself get out and run.

bus.said: you don't animate the person entering the car, nor do you animate them leaving the car
bus.did: The people getting off are seen stepping down from the door and walking away. They were only a number.

drone.said: The rings are ugly.  Make them nore pretty
drone.did: The hoops were one plain tube each. Each is now a gate of light: a neon core, a glow, a halo, and lamps that chase round it; each hoop is the next colour.

rope.said: You have to do better on the animation animation hands and the person holding the vines and swinging
rope.did: The walker was the same pill on two sticks, with arms fixed in the air. He is now a person with elbows, knees and hands, both hands closed on the pole, placing one foot in front of the other; he flails when he falls.

balloon.said: make the circle distinct from the water color so its easy to see
balloon.did: The target's rings were thin and washed out by the haze. They are wider, a stronger red, with a dark edge, and drawn without haze.
